Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchedCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		isValid: Boolean = if BankCard.allInstance()->exists(o|o.CardID = cardid) 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(o: BankCard|o.CardID)
	postcondition:
		self.CardIDValidated = isValid and
		(isValid = true and
		self.InputCard = matchedCard or
		isValid = false and
		self.InputCard = null) and
		result = isValid
}
